description: Lists every service that has a published item, with its number of items, how many of them are upcoming and the date of the next one. Use it to find the slug of a service before you filter search_items by service, or to see what is tracked for one cloud.

cloud.description: Only the services of this cloud.

q.description: Search text of at most 100 characters. Every word must occur in the name or the slug of the service.

name: list_services

as_of.description: The UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD) every value that depends on the day was counted for.

count.description: Number of services in this answer.

generated_at.description: Moment this answer was built (ISO 8601, UTC).

name.description: Name of the license, or the words that say none is chosen yet.

note.description: What that means for reuse of the data.

url.description: Address of the license text, or null when there is none.

services.description: The services, by cloud and then by name.

cloud.description: Cloud or product group the item belongs to: azure, aws, gcp, oci, m365, github or multi.

count.description: Number of published items for the service.

json_url.description: The items of the service as JSON.

next_effective_date.description: The effective_date of the soonest upcoming item of the service, or null when none has a date. For a month, quarter or year this is the first day of the period.

next_effective_precision.description: How exact next_effective_date is: day, month, quarter or year. Null without a date.

service.description: Display name of the affected service.

upcoming.description: How many of them are upcoming on the as_of day: the effective period is not over. An item without a date counts as upcoming.

url.description: Page of the service on the site.

site.description: The site the data comes from.

title: List services
